subject: Request: one-time sign-on + cash-prorate for senior inference hire (N. Shah)
messages:
From: Rishi Khatri <rishi.khatri@talentbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate ready for offer - Nina Shah (Senior Inference Engineer)

Hi Marcus —

Quick heads-up: Nina Shah (ex-Datasurge lead infra) completed final loop last week and is excited about Redwood. She has a competing offer from Cloudmere with a higher cash component and a mid-cycle sign-on. Recruiter note: candidate needs decision by EOD Wed to avoid losing momentum.

Proposed package we can present (standard band):
- Base: $205,000
- Target bonus: 15%
- RSU: 0.35% over 4 years (standard band for Senior Inference)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (pro-rated) — candidate requested $30k to match Cloudmere

She has 10+ yrs infra + model serving experience and immediate impact on our latency roadmap. Recruiter thinks a one-time cash uplift will keep her in pipeline.

Attaching CV and comp band reference. Any chance of approving a one-time spot sign-on to bridge the gap?

Thanks,
Rishi
TalentBridge | Senior Recruiter
attachments: nina_shah_cv.pdf, comp-band-ref.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Khatri <rishi.khatri@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate ready for offer - Nina Shah (Senior Inference Engineer)

Laura / Ben —

Putting this on your radar and asking for an exception approval. Short rationale:
- Direct hire for inference infra team: immediate owner for KV cache improvements and compilation tuning; realistic delivery in Q4.
- Candidate has multiple competing offers; risk of losing pipeline if we only match band.
- We propose a one-time sign-on of $25,000 (split: $15k cash now, $10k cash after 6 months) and prorated joining bonus for relocation. No change to base or RSU band.

Request: authorize a one-time out-of-band cash supplement (not band change) and sign-off to proceed with verbal offer. If approved I will route final offer packet to Legal/Total Rewards for processing.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Inference Platforms | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate ready for offer - Nina Shah (Senior Inference Engineer)

Marcus —

Thanks for the context. A few questions before I greenlight:
1) Why not increase RSU cadence instead of cash? That preserves budget against headcount.
2) What is expected time-to-impact metric you are comfortable committing to (30/60/90 plan)?
3) Please confirm hiring manager sign-off on the 6-month clawback if the second tranche is tied to tenure.

We can approve a single one-time sign-on up to $20k without exec escalation, provided we include a 6-month clawback and a short performance checkpoint at 90 days. Anything above $20k requires VP sign-off.

Please reply with the 90-day impact plan and confirm clawback language and I'll take this to Aditya for final review if needed.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Talent | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Khatri <rishi.khatri@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 13:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate ready for offer - Nina Shah (Senior Inference Engineer)

Laura —

Answers inline:
1) RSU increase: candidate prefers cash liquidity given counteroffer structure; pushing more RSU risks losing them. Candidate has recently vested at Datasurge and values cash. I prefer sign-on split to hit both retention and approvals.
2) 30/60/90 impact plan (high level):
  - 30d: onboard + reproduce 1 infra perf regression from the benchmark suite; join postmortem cadence
  - 60d: implement KV cache micro-optimizations for two high-tail models; land first benchmark improvement
  - 90d: lead rollout of compilation parameter set for low-latency variant; documented perf gains and cost delta
3) Yes — hiring manager (me) will include a 6-month clawback on the second tranche, recoverable if employee leaves within 6 months.

Given the timing pressure, I request approval for a $25k total sign-on but can proceed with $20k immediate approval and escalate the extra $5k to Aditya if needed. If you okay $20k now, I'll present that tonight and keep candidate warm.

-Marcus
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Khatri <rishi.khatri@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate ready for offer - Nina Shah (Senior Inference Engineer)

All —

I approve a one-time sign-on of $20,000 cash (distributed $12k at start, $8k at 6 months) with the 6-month clawback and 90-day performance checkpoint per Marcus's plan. Please prepare offer materials and route to Legal / Total Rewards for execution. If Marcus needs an extra $5k to match the counter completely, escalate to Aditya and cc me.

Marcus — please send finalized offer packet and include DocuSign link once Legal uploads. Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Ben Carter
VP, Global Sales & GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
